# Dr Abderrahim Zermane

Official website: https://azermane.com/

Dr Abderrahim Zermane is a fire and process safety researcher specialising in physics-based urban fire modelling, occupational accident prevention, fault tree analysis, explainable machine learning, hydrogen fire safety and evidence-led decision systems.

## Flagship publications
- Predicting fatal fall from heights accidents using random forest classification machine-learning model — Safety Science 159 (2023) 106023.
- Risk assessment of fatal accidents due to work-at-heights activities using fault tree analysis — Safety Science 151 (2022) 105724.
- Linking Accident Data and Physics-Based Modeling for Hydrogen Fire Safety — Fire Technology 62(5) (2026), Article 128.
